lines: I lost every road for a while. You <pulse>marked the way back</pulse>.
I remember your face like a landmark after a long, wrong journey.
You helped pull me back when even my name felt far away.
The map of that memory is torn, but your name sits near the center.
I remember wandering inside myself. Then a path opened, and you were beside it.
The memory is rough around the edges, but your face stayed in it.
I remember you, yes. Some routes back home still pass through frightening country.
I know you helped. I also remember why my hands still shake.
The cure left echoes behind. Stand where I can breathe around them.
I have seen broken cartography with better instincts than you.
